title: Pour It Like You Mean It
headline: Some sauces you dip. This one you pour.
sub: The Mala. Wagyu. That Szechuan tingle.
concept: A cinematic drizzle reel. Mala glaze pours over the Wagyu in slow motion under one hard spotlight on black — steam rising, lotus root catching light, glaze dripping off the edge. ASMR pour + sizzle, no talking. Sauce is the hero.
shotFlow: 0–2s HOOK: gloved hand tilts the green-tip bottle, first drop hits
2–5s slow-mo pour, glaze sheets over the patty
5–8s macro drip off the bun + crispy lotus crunch
8–12s pull to hero, text slam 'POUR IT LIKE YOU MEAN IT'
12–15s end card — MALA · ฿520 · Order on Grab
caption: Some burgers you eat. The Mala you survive. Szechuan glaze, Wagyu, crispy lotus root — poured, not politely added. Glove up. Pour it your way.
artDirection: Single hard key light · pure black bg · sauce = brightest object · green-tip bottle = brand cue · shoot 120fps
